campaigns.name: Keep on the Borderlands
campaigns.description: ★ Recommended Start! A classic beginner adventure! Defend the Keep on the Borderlands and explore the infamous Caves of Chaos. Perfect for new adventurers learning the ways of dungeon delving.

milestones.title: Prologue: Arrival at the Keep
milestones.objective: Arrive at the Keep and find lodging
milestones.description: You are a fledgling adventurer seeking fame and fortune. The Keep on the Borderlands offers shelter and opportunity for those brave enough to face the wilderness beyond.

milestones.title: Chapter 1: The Keep
milestones.objective: Explore the Keep and gather information
milestones.description: The Keep is a bastion of civilization on the edge of the wild. Meet the inhabitants, gather supplies, and learn of the dangers lurking in the Caves of Chaos.

milestones.title: Chapter 2: The Wilderness
milestones.objective: Navigate the wilderness and find the Caves
milestones.description: Between the Keep and the Caves of Chaos lies dangerous wilderness. Bandits, wild beasts, and worse prey on the unwary.

milestones.title: Chapter 3: Caves of Chaos - Outer Caves
milestones.objective: Clear the outer caves of monsters
milestones.description: The Caves of Chaos are a ravine filled with monster lairs. Goblins, orcs, and kobolds vie for territory in the outer caves.

milestones.title: Chapter 4: Caves of Chaos - Inner Caves
milestones.objective: Venture deeper into the caves
milestones.description: Deeper in the ravine, more dangerous creatures lurk. Hobgoblins, gnolls, and bugbears have made their homes here.

milestones.title: Chapter 5: The Temple of Evil Chaos
milestones.objective: Destroy the Temple of Evil Chaos
milestones.description: At the heart of the ravine lies a hidden temple where evil priests conduct dark rituals. They are the true masterminds behind the monster alliance!

milestones.title: Epilogue: Heroes of the Borderlands
milestones.objective: Return to the Keep as heroes
milestones.description: With the Temple destroyed and the Caves cleared, peace returns to the Borderlands. You are celebrated as heroes!

campaigns.name: Night's Dark Terror
campaigns.description: A classic adventure in the Grand Duchy of Karameikos. Escort a horse trader home, only to find his family's homestead under siege by goblin wolf-riders!

milestones.title: Prologue: Journey to Sukiskyn
milestones.objective: Travel to Sukiskyn homestead
milestones.description: You have been hired by Stephan, a horse trader, to escort him to his family's homestead at Sukiskyn in the wilderness of Karameikos.

milestones.title: Chapter 1: Siege of Sukiskyn
milestones.objective: Defend Sukiskyn from the goblin attack
milestones.description: Goblin wolf-riders have laid siege to the Sukiskyn homestead! The Sukiskyn family desperately needs your help to defend their home.

milestones.title: Chapter 2: The Kidnapping
milestones.objective: Track the goblins and rescue the prisoners
milestones.description: During the attack, Stephan's brother has been kidnapped by the goblins! Tracks lead into the Dymrak Forest.

milestones.title: Chapter 3: Xitaqa's Lair
milestones.objective: Infiltrate Xitaqa's lair and defeat him
milestones.description: The trail leads to ancient ruins where a goblin king named Xitaqa has established his lair.

milestones.title: Chapter 4: The Iron Ring
milestones.objective: Investigate the Iron Ring's operations
milestones.description: You discover the goblins were working with the Iron Ring - a sinister slaving organization operating in Karameikos.

milestones.title: Chapter 5: The Lost Valley
milestones.objective: Find the Lost Valley and stop the Iron Ring
milestones.description: Clues point to a hidden valley where the Iron Ring has a secret base and ancient Hutaakan ruins hold dark secrets.

milestones.title: Epilogue: Heroes of Karameikos
milestones.objective: Celebrate your victory!
milestones.description: With the Iron Ring defeated and the valley's secrets revealed, you have become legendary heroes of the Grand Duchy.

campaigns.name: Curse of Strahd
campaigns.description: A gothic horror adventure in the mist-shrouded land of Barovia. Face the vampire lord Strahd von Zarovich and uncover the dark secrets of Castle Ravenloft!

milestones.title: Prologue: Into the Mists
milestones.objective: Find shelter and learn where you are
milestones.description: Mysterious mists surround you and your companions. When they clear, you find yourselves in a dark, unfamiliar land.

milestones.title: Chapter 1: Village of Barovia
milestones.objective: Help Ismark protect his sister Ireena
milestones.description: The village of Barovia is a place of fear and despair. The locals speak in hushed tones of the Devil Strahd who rules this land.

milestones.title: Chapter 2: The Fortune Teller
milestones.objective: Visit Madam Eva at Tser Pool
milestones.description: Madam Eva, a Vistani seer, has offered to read your fortune. The cards will reveal the path to defeating Strahd.

milestones.title: Chapter 3: The Town of Vallaki
milestones.objective: Investigate the troubles in Vallaki
milestones.description: Vallaki is a larger town trying to resist Strahd's influence. But dark forces work within its walls.

milestones.title: Chapter 4: The Wizard's Tower
milestones.objective: Find allies to stand against Strahd
milestones.description: The mad wizard's tower holds secrets and powerful allies. But the wizard himself may be beyond saving.

milestones.title: Chapter 5: The Amber Temple
milestones.objective: Uncover the source of Strahd's power
milestones.description: Ancient evil lurks in the Amber Temple, where dark vestiges offer forbidden power.

milestones.title: Chapter 6: Castle Ravenloft
milestones.objective: Defeat Strahd von Zarovich
milestones.description: The time has come to confront Strahd in his castle. The fate of Barovia hangs in the balance.

milestones.title: Epilogue: Dawn Over Barovia
milestones.objective: Celebrate freedom!
milestones.description: With Strahd defeated, the mists begin to lift. Barovia is finally free from darkness.

campaigns.name: Tomb of Annihilation
campaigns.description: A deadly expedition into the jungles of Chult to end the Death Curse. Dinosaurs, undead, and an ancient tomb of horrors await!

milestones.title: Prologue: The Death Curse
milestones.objective: Travel to Port Nyanzaru and find a guide
milestones.description: A mysterious curse is killing those who have been raised from the dead. The source lies somewhere in the jungle peninsula of Chult.

milestones.title: Chapter 1: Port Nyanzaru
milestones.objective: Gather supplies and information about the Soulmonger
milestones.description: The vibrant trading port of Chult teems with merchants, dinosaur races, and rumors of treasure in the jungle.

milestones.title: Chapter 2: The Jungle
milestones.objective: Navigate the jungle and find clues to the Soulmonger's location
milestones.description: The steaming jungles of Chult are filled with ancient ruins, deadly predators, and undead horrors.

milestones.title: Chapter 3: Omu, The Forbidden City
milestones.objective: Collect the puzzle cubes from the Nine Shrines
milestones.description: The lost city of Omu lies in ruin, overrun by yuan-ti and the mysterious shrines of the Trickster Gods.

milestones.title: Chapter 4: The Fane of the Night Serpent
milestones.objective: Infiltrate the yuan-ti temple and find the entrance to the tomb
milestones.description: Deep beneath Omu lies the yuan-ti temple. Their leader serves an even darker master.

milestones.title: Chapter 5: The Tomb of the Nine Gods
milestones.objective: Descend into the tomb and destroy the Soulmonger
milestones.description: The legendary Tomb of Annihilation awaits. Acererak's deadliest traps and the Soulmonger lie within.

milestones.title: Epilogue: Curse Lifted
milestones.objective: Celebrate your victory!
milestones.description: With the Soulmonger destroyed, the Death Curse ends. Chult begins to heal, and the souls trapped within are freed.

campaigns.name: Lost Mine of Phandelver
campaigns.description: The classic D&D 5th Edition starter adventure! Escort supplies to the frontier town of Phandalin, but danger lurks on the Triboar Trail. Goblins, bandits, and a mysterious villain seek the legendary Wave Echo Cave!

milestones.title: Prologue: The Triboar Trail
milestones.objective: Escort the wagon safely to Phandalin
milestones.description: You've been hired by Gundren Rockseeker to escort a wagon of supplies to the frontier town of Phandalin. Gundren and his bodyguard Sildar have ridden ahead, promising to meet you in town.

milestones.title: Chapter 1: Goblin Trouble
milestones.objective: Rescue Sildar and discover what happened to Gundren
milestones.description: The road is blocked by dead horses - an ambush! Gundren and Sildar are missing, and goblin tracks lead into the forest. The Cragmaw tribe is behind this.

milestones.title: Chapter 2: Phandalin
milestones.objective: Deal with the Redbrand menace
milestones.description: The small frontier town is being terrorized by the Redbrands - thugs who work for someone called Glasstaff. The townsfolk desperately need heroes.

milestones.title: Chapter 3: Secrets of Tresendar Manor
milestones.objective: Infiltrate the Redbrand hideout and confront Glasstaff
milestones.description: The Redbrand hideout lies beneath the old Tresendar Manor. Their leader Glasstaff knows something about Gundren's disappearance and the mysterious Black Spider.

milestones.title: Chapter 4: Cragmaw Castle
milestones.objective: Storm Cragmaw Castle and rescue Gundren
milestones.description: The goblin stronghold of Cragmaw Castle is where King Grol holds Gundren prisoner. The Black Spider wants information about Wave Echo Cave.

milestones.title: Chapter 5: Wave Echo Cave
milestones.objective: Explore Wave Echo Cave and stop the Black Spider
milestones.description: The legendary lost mine has been found! Within lies the Forge of Spells, a magical forge from the ancient Phandelver's Pact. But the Black Spider has already entered the cave...

milestones.title: Epilogue: Heroes of Phandalin
milestones.objective: Celebrate your victory!
milestones.description: With the Black Spider defeated and Wave Echo Cave secured, Phandalin can finally prosper. You are celebrated as the heroes who saved the town!
